note: Source AM-63-fol 110: Finnr is the subject of marriage attribution, following Finnr Árnason. This document has no POS annotation; inferred finna/VB is wrong. Kaikki s.v. Finnr is a male given name. Use a reviewed local name repair, not the general annotated rule.

Source Lbs-fragm-82 1r:13 has the river-name constituents Ǫ́ en and helga. Óttarr Knútsdrápa 11 (https://www.heimskringla.no/wiki/Kn%C3%BAtsdr%C3%A1pa) identifies the Holy River; isolate both constituents as names, retaining helgr elsewhere.
